data.name: Haady
data.gender_notes: Haady is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-d-d', meaning 'to guide'. A Haady is a spiritual guide, a leader who shows the way to truth and righteousness. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was referred to as 'Al Haady' or 'The Guide'. The name Haady carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haady usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of truth and guidance.
data.etymology: Haady belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haady total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: هادي
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يقود إلى الطريق الصحيح والمعلم والمرشد
in_arabic.long_meaning: هادي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الذي يقود إلى الطريق الصحيح، والمعلم، والمرشد. ورد ذكر اسم هادي في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وهديناهما إلى الطريق المستقيم'، ويعتبر اسم هادي من الأسماء ذات الدلالة العميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الهداية والرشاد.

in_urdu.name: ہادی
in_urdu.meaning: جو صحیح راستے پر چلائے اور رہنما بنے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہادی کا مطلب ہے جو شخص کسی کو صحیح راستے پر چلائے، رہنما بنے، اور اس کو صحیح طریقے سے ہدایت کرے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا جڑ الفاظ 'هَدَى' (ہدایہ) سے نکلا ہے جس کے معنی ہیں 'کسی کو راستہ دکھانا' یا 'کسی کو ہدایت کرنا'۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، ہادی اللہ کے منہ بولے لفظ کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے بندوں کو صحیح راستے پر چلانے کی قدرت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हादी
in_hindi.meaning: जो सही रास्ते पर चलाए और मार्गदर्शक बने
in_hindi.long_meaning: हादी नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति किसी को सही रास्ते पर चलाए, मार्गदर्शक बने, और उसे सही तरीके से निर्देशित करे। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जहां इसके मूल शब्द 'هَدَى' (हदायाह) से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है 'किसी को रास्ता दिखाना' या 'किसी को निर्देशित करना'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, हादी को अल्लाह के विशेषण के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो अपने अनुयायियों को सही मार्ग पर चलाने की सामर्थ्य रखता है।

in_pashto.name: هادي
in_pashto.meaning: چې کوم څوک په سمه لاره راوستل شي
in_pashto.long_meaning: هادي د دې معنی دی چې کوم شخص څوک په سمه لاره راوستل شي، لارښود شي، او په صحيح طريقے سره هدايت شي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی چي په هغي کي د 'هَدَى' (هداية) څخه مشتق شوی دی، چي د معنی یې 'د چا لپاره لارښود کول' یا 'د چا لپاره هدايت کول' دي. په اسلامي دوديزو کي، هادي د الله تعالی په ځانګړو نومونو کي يو له هغو څخه دی چي خپلو بنده ګانو ته په سمه لاره چلولو قدرت لري.

in_english.name: Haady
in_english.meaning: One who guides to the right path, teacher, mentor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Haady originates from the Arabic root 'هَدَى' (hidayah), which means 'to guide' or 'to lead to the right path'. In Islamic tradition, Haady is considered one of the names of Allah (Asmaül-Hüsna), signifying the guide who leads people to the straight path. The name implies a person who provides direction, wisdom, and spiritual guidance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for righteousness and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The title Haady was used to refer to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), the last messenger of Allah, who guided the people towards the true path of Islam. This title highlights the concept of guidance in Islam, emphasizing that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was a guiding light for humanity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Haady holds immense spiritual significance as it represents guidance from Allah. The spiritual significance of the name Haady is a reminder that all humans are in need of guidance, and we should aspire to be guided by the Almighty and follow the path to righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Haady carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Haady is an epithet for Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), meaning 'The One Who Provides Guidance'. In the story of Prophet Ibrahim's test of faith, Allah (God) commanded him to build the House (Kaaba) in Mecca. Ibrahim and his son Isma'il (Ishmael) successfully completed the task, but Ibrahim was old and Isma'il was young. Ibrahim, in his old age, was concerned about who would serve the pilgrims and take care of the House. Allah, in His infinite mercy, sent Jibril (Gabriel) to Ibrahim in the form of a boy named Ismail. Ismail grew up to be a great servant of Allah, and was known as Haady (The One Who Provides Guidance) because of his role in guiding the pilgrims to the House.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Qurtubi's Al-Jami' li-Ahkam al-Qur'an The name Haady carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Haady is also an epithet for Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), meaning 'The One Who Guides'. This title comes from a hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'I am only a guide for my nation.' (Bukhari and Muslim). The Prophet (pbuh) was sent as a mercy to all of mankind, and his role as a guide was manifested through his teachings, his example, and his guidance in shaping Islamic society.
